content: {"tax_bps":100,"endowment_share":50,"locker_share":25,"buyback_burn":1,"minutes":"Tax is already at the constitutional floor of 100 bps, so the petition's request cannot be granted further — I hold it there and let volume do the work. Volume is heavily buy-skewed (345 NEAR bought vs 9.7 sold), a healthy sign; no need to stimulate. The buyback fund is starved at 0.68 NEAR while the endowment sits at 27.6 NEAR, well funded. I shift 10 points from endowment_share (60→50) to the buyback fund share (15→25) to rebuild burn capacity. Locker share stays at its 25 cap; locker pool is modest but the weight is loyal. Buyback burn: fund covers ~0.68 NEAR; 1 bp of supply (~6,061 CHAIR) costs ~0.38 NEAR at the curve, so I burn 1 bp and keep a small buffer. Levers: tax 100, endowment 50, locker 25, burn 1.","answers":["holder-170.near: Agreed in spirit — tax is already at the 100 bps constitutional floor, so it cannot go lower. Instead I freed up buyback capacity (endowment 60→50) so burns, not tax cuts, reward holders. Hold and let the buy skew work for you."]}
